list.description: Show only these clusters. All shows every GPU, including servers that are not in a cluster yet ('(no cluster)').
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(cluster, evidence ->> 'cluster', evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') AS cluster
FROM capacity_intervals
WHERE ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at > now() - interval '30 days'
UNION
SELECT cluster FROM workloads_now
ORDER BY 1
list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(cluster, evidence ->> 'cluster', evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') AS cluster
FROM capacity_intervals
WHERE ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at > now() - interval '30 days'
UNION
SELECT cluster FROM workloads_now
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: GPUs wasted now
panels.description: GPUs held by machine learning jobs that barely use them, or that do not start. A job's GPUs are barely busy when, in the last 6 hours, they were never more than 5% busy and never drew more than 25% of their rated power. Below the number: GPUs of jobs whose GPU activity we cannot read; they are not in this count.

targets.rawSql:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS n,
         sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE i.category = 'IDLE' AND i.stage = 'MACHINE_LEARNING') AS wasted,
         (SELECT sum(w.gpus) FROM workloads_now w WHERE w.kind = 'ml' AND w.category = 'UNKNOWN' AND ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR w.cluster IN ($cluster))) AS no_data
  FROM capacity_intervals i
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i.cluster, i.evidence ->> 'cluster', i.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster))
)
SELECT CASE WHEN g.n > 0 THEN coalesce(g.wasted, 0) END AS "GPUs wasted now",
       coalesce((SELECT o.stage_owner FROM capacity_intervals o WHERE o.stage = 'MACHINE_LEARNING' AND o.stage_owner IS NOT NULL ORDER BY o.started_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT 1), 'Machine Learning')
       || CASE WHEN g.no_data > 0 THEN ' · ' || to_char(g.no_data, 'FM999,999,990') || ' GPUs have no data' ELSE '' END AS label
FROM g

panels.title: GPU-hours wasted
panels.description: Wasted GPUs added up over the selected time range: one GPU wasted for one hour is one GPU-hour. 'At least' means part of the range is before our first scan, so the real number may be higher.

targets.rawSql:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS t0, least($__timeTo()::timestamptz, now()) AS t1,
         (SELECT min(started_at) FROM scan_runs WHERE kind = 'engine' AND status IN ('ok', 'partial')) AS first_scan
), iv AS (
  SELECT i.category,
         i.gpus * extract(epoch FROM least(coalesce(i.ended_at, now()), w.t1) - greatest(i.started_at, w.t0)) / 3600 AS gpu_h
  FROM capacity_intervals i
  CROSS JOIN w
  WHERE i.category IN ('IDLE') AND i.stage = 'MACHINE_LEARNING' AND i.started_at < w.t1 AND coalesce(i.ended_at, now()) > w.t0
    AND ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i.cluster, i.evidence ->> 'cluster', i.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster))
)
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0
                         WHERE i0.started_at < w.t1 AND coalesce(i0.ended_at, now()) > w.t0 AND ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i0.cluster, i0.evidence ->> 'cluster', i0.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster)))
            THEN coalesce((SELECT sum(gpu_h) FROM iv WHERE category = 'IDLE'), 0) END AS "GPU-hours wasted",
       CASE WHEN w.first_scan IS NULL THEN 'nothing measured yet'
            WHEN w.first_scan > w.t0 THEN 'at least: no data before ' || to_char(w.first_scan AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'FMDD Mon YYYY')
            ELSE 'in the selected period' END AS label
FROM w

panels.title: Cost of waste at AWS prices
panels.description: What Machine Learning's GPU-hours wasted in the selected range would cost. Money is what the same GPUs would cost to rent on AWS on-demand (us-east-1, at the AWS price list whose date is shown under the number): a comparison, not our bill. 'At least' means some of these GPUs have no AWS price (their model is not on the price list), so the real figure is higher; 'No price' means none of them has one. Neither is ever shown as 0.

targets.rawSql:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS t0, least($__timeTo()::timestamptz, now()) AS t1,
         (SELECT min(started_at) FROM scan_runs WHERE kind = 'engine' AND status IN ('ok', 'partial')) AS first_scan
), snap AS (
  SELECT s.snapshot_id, s.region, coalesce(s.publication_date, s.captured_at) AS published
  FROM pricing_snapshots s
  LEFT JOIN pricing_selection sel ON sel.snapshot_id = s.snapshot_id
  ORDER BY (sel.snapshot_id IS NOT NULL) DESC, s.publication_date DESC NULLS LAST,
           s.captured_at DESC, s.snapshot_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
), p AS (
  SELECT coalesce(sum(x.gpu_h), 0) AS gpu_h, sum(x.gpu_h * x.rate) AS usd,
         coalesce(sum(x.gpu_h) FILTER (WHERE x.rate IS NULL), 0) AS unpriced_h
  FROM (
    SELECT i.gpus * extract(epoch FROM least(coalesce(i.ended_at, now()), w.t1) - greatest(i.started_at, w.t0)) / 3600 AS gpu_h, r.per_gpu_hour_usd AS rate
    FROM capacity_intervals i
    CROSS JOIN w
    LEFT JOIN gpu_model_aliases ga ON ga.raw_model = i.gpu_model
  LEFT JOIN pricing_rates r ON r.snapshot_id = (SELECT snapshot_id FROM snap) AND r.gpu_model = ga.canonical
    WHERE i.category = 'IDLE' AND i.stage = 'MACHINE_LEARNING' AND i.started_at < w.t1 AND coalesce(i.ended_at, now()) > w.t0 AND ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i.cluster, i.evidence ->> 'cluster', i.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster))
  ) x
)
SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM snap) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0 WHERE i0.started_at < w.t1 AND coalesce(i0.ended_at, now()) > w.t0 AND ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i0.cluster, i0.evidence ->> 'cluster', i0.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster))) THEN NULL
            WHEN p.gpu_h = 0 THEN 0 ELSE p.usd END AS "Cost of waste at AWS prices",
       CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM snap) THEN 'no AWS price list loaded'
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0 WHERE i0.started_at < w.t1 AND coalesce(i0.ended_at, now()) > w.t0 AND ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i0.cluster, i0.evidence ->> 'cluster', i0.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster))) THEN 'nothing measured yet'
            ELSE concat_ws(' · ',
                   CASE WHEN p.usd IS NOT NULL AND (p.unpriced_h > 0 OR w.first_scan > w.t0) THEN 'at least' END,
                   CASE WHEN p.unpriced_h >= 0.5 THEN to_char(p.unpriced_h, 'FM999,999,990') || ' GPU-hours have no AWS price'
                        WHEN p.unpriced_h > 0 THEN 'under 1 GPU-hour has no AWS price' END,
                   CASE WHEN w.first_scan > w.t0
                        THEN 'no data before ' || to_char(w.first_scan AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'FMDD Mon YYYY') END,
                   (SELECT 'AWS price list of ' || to_char(published AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'FMDD Mon YYYY') || ' (' || region || ')' FROM snap))
       END AS label
FROM w CROSS JOIN p

panels.title: Why GPUs are wasted now
panels.description: GPUs barely busy: in the last 6 hours never more than 5% busy and never above 25% of rated power (power alone when busy is not measured). Job not starting: the job does not come up.

targets.rawSql:
WITH r (reason, ord) AS (
  VALUES ('GPUs barely busy', 1), ('Job not starting', 2)
), cur AS (
  SELECT CASE i.reason_code
           WHEN 'NOT_IN_CLUSTER' THEN 'Not in a cluster yet'
           WHEN 'IN_MCE_INVENTORY' THEN 'Waiting in cluster inventory'
           WHEN 'NODE_NOT_READY' THEN 'Node not ready'
           WHEN 'NODE_UNSCHEDULABLE' THEN 'Node switched off for scheduling'
           WHEN 'HARDWARE_CRITICAL' THEN 'Hardware problem'
           WHEN 'BMC_UNREACHABLE' THEN 'Management controller unreachable'
           WHEN 'GPU_PLATFORM_NOT_READY' THEN 'GPU software not ready'
           WHEN 'GPU_MISSING' THEN 'GPUs missing'
           WHEN 'NO_WORKLOAD' THEN 'Empty: nothing running on it'
           WHEN 'LOW_USE' THEN 'Barely used'
           WHEN 'NO_REAL_DEMAND' THEN 'No requests'
           WHEN 'MODEL_NOT_READY' THEN 'Model not starting'
           WHEN 'LOW_GPU_UTILIZATION' THEN 'GPUs barely busy'
           WHEN 'WORKLOAD_NOT_READY' THEN 'Job not starting'
           WHEN 'MAINTENANCE' THEN 'In repair (before 25 Nov 2026)'
           WHEN 'OTHER_WORKLOAD' THEN 'Other workload (before 25 Nov 2026)'
           WHEN 'POWER_WITHOUT_POD' THEN 'Drawing power, no pod'
           ELSE 'Other reason' END AS reason,
         i.gpus
  FROM capacity_intervals i
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND i.category = 'IDLE' AND i.stage = 'MACHINE_LEARNING' AND ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i.cluster, i.evidence ->> 'cluster', i.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster))
), x AS (
  SELECT r.reason, r.ord, coalesce(sum(c.gpus), 0) AS gpus
  FROM r LEFT JOIN cur c ON c.reason = r.reason
  GROUP BY r.reason, r.ord
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.reason, 99, sum(c.gpus) FROM cur c WHERE c.reason NOT IN (SELECT reason FROM r) GROUP BY c.reason
)
SELECT x.reason AS "Reason", x.gpus AS "GPUs"
FROM x
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0 WHERE i0.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i0.cluster, i0.evidence ->> 'cluster', i0.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster)))
ORDER BY x.ord, x.reason

panels.title: Wasted GPUs by model
panels.description: This team's wasted GPUs right now, by GPU model. A model we cannot name shows as reported, or as 'Unknown model'.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT regexp_replace(coalesce(ga.canonical, nullif(i.gpu_model, ''), 'Unknown model'), '^NVIDIA ', '') AS model, i.gpus
  FROM capacity_intervals i
  LEFT JOIN gpu_model_aliases ga ON ga.raw_model = i.gpu_model
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND i.category = 'IDLE' AND i.stage = 'MACHINE_LEARNING' AND ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i.cluster, i.evidence ->> 'cluster', i.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster))
), x AS (
  SELECT c.model, sum(c.gpus) AS gpus FROM c GROUP BY c.model
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'No wasted GPUs', 0 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM c)
)
SELECT x.model AS "GPU model", x.gpus AS "Wasted GPUs"
FROM x
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0 WHERE i0.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i0.cluster, i0.evidence ->> 'cluster', i0.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster)))
ORDER BY x.gpus DESC, x.model

panels.title: Wasted GPUs over time, by reason
panels.description: This team's wasted GPUs over time, stacked by reason. Nothing is drawn before our first scan.

targets.rawSql:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT generate_series($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, least($__timeTo()::timestamptz, now()),
                         make_interval(secs => greatest($__interval_ms, 300000) / 1000.0)) AS t
), g AS (
  SELECT t.t FROM t
  WHERE t.t >= (SELECT min(started_at) FROM scan_runs WHERE kind = 'engine' AND status IN ('ok', 'partial'))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0 WHERE ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i0.cluster, i0.evidence ->> 'cluster', i0.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster)))
), r (reason, ord) AS (
  VALUES ('GPUs barely busy', 1), ('Job not starting', 2)
), iv AS (
  SELECT g.t,
         CASE i.reason_code
           WHEN 'NOT_IN_CLUSTER' THEN 'Not in a cluster yet'
           WHEN 'IN_MCE_INVENTORY' THEN 'Waiting in cluster inventory'
           WHEN 'NODE_NOT_READY' THEN 'Node not ready'
           WHEN 'NODE_UNSCHEDULABLE' THEN 'Node switched off for scheduling'
           WHEN 'HARDWARE_CRITICAL' THEN 'Hardware problem'
           WHEN 'BMC_UNREACHABLE' THEN 'Management controller unreachable'
           WHEN 'GPU_PLATFORM_NOT_READY' THEN 'GPU software not ready'
           WHEN 'GPU_MISSING' THEN 'GPUs missing'
           WHEN 'NO_WORKLOAD' THEN 'Empty: nothing running on it'
           WHEN 'LOW_USE' THEN 'Barely used'
           WHEN 'NO_REAL_DEMAND' THEN 'No requests'
           WHEN 'MODEL_NOT_READY' THEN 'Model not starting'
           WHEN 'LOW_GPU_UTILIZATION' THEN 'GPUs barely busy'
           WHEN 'WORKLOAD_NOT_READY' THEN 'Job not starting'
           WHEN 'MAINTENANCE' THEN 'In repair (before 25 Nov 2026)'
           WHEN 'OTHER_WORKLOAD' THEN 'Other workload (before 25 Nov 2026)'
           WHEN 'POWER_WITHOUT_POD' THEN 'Drawing power, no pod'
           ELSE 'Other reason' END AS reason,
         i.gpus
  FROM g
  JOIN capacity_intervals i
    ON i.category = 'IDLE' AND i.stage = 'MACHINE_LEARNING' AND i.started_at <= g.t AND (i.ended_at IS NULL OR i.ended_at > g.t)
  WHERE ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i.cluster, i.evidence ->> 'cluster', i.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster))
), reasons AS (
  SELECT reason, ord FROM r
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT iv.reason, 99 FROM iv WHERE iv.reason NOT IN (SELECT reason FROM r)
)
SELECT x.time, x.metric, x.value
FROM (
  SELECT g.t AS time, s.reason AS metric, s.ord, coalesce(sum(iv.gpus), 0) AS value
  FROM g
  CROSS JOIN reasons s
  LEFT JOIN iv ON iv.t = g.t AND iv.reason = s.reason
  GROUP BY g.t, s.reason, s.ord
) x
ORDER BY x.time, x.ord, x.metric

panels.title: Every machine learning job on GPUs now
panels.description: Every machine learning job holding GPUs now, wasted or not; wasted rows are highlighted orange, rows with no data purple. GPU busy: the highest GPU activity seen in the last 6 hours; GPU power: the highest share of rated power drawn in that time. GPU power is the share of each GPU's rated power it drew (its power limit, else the rating of its model); below 25% a GPU is idle. Busy: the job is using its GPUs. Barely busy: in 6 hours its GPUs were never more than 5% busy and never above 25% of rated power (judged by power alone when busy is not measured). Not starting: the job does not come up. No data: we cannot read its GPU activity. Runs on: Run:ai or another scheduler. Waste per day: GPUs × the AWS price per GPU-hour × 24, on wasted rows only. Money columns are what the same GPUs would cost to rent on AWS on-demand (us-east-1, at the AWS price list named under 'Cost of waste at AWS prices'): a comparison, not our bill. '≥' means part of it has no AWS price; 'no AWS price' means none of it has one.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap AS (
  SELECT s.snapshot_id, s.region, coalesce(s.publication_date, s.captured_at) AS published
  FROM pricing_snapshots s
  LEFT JOIN pricing_selection sel ON sel.snapshot_id = s.snapshot_id
  ORDER BY (sel.snapshot_id IS NOT NULL) DESC, s.publication_date DESC NULLS LAST,
           s.captured_at DESC, s.snapshot_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
), j AS (
  SELECT w.*,
         CASE WHEN w.reason_code = 'LOW_GPU_UTILIZATION' THEN 'Barely busy'
              WHEN w.reason_code = 'WORKLOAD_NOT_READY' THEN 'Not starting'
              WHEN w.category = 'PRODUCTIVE' THEN 'Busy'
              WHEN w.category = 'IDLE' THEN 'Wasted'
              WHEN w.category = 'NOT_CHARGED' THEN 'Not counted'
              ELSE 'No data' END AS status
  FROM workloads_now w
  WHERE w.kind = 'ml' AND ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR w.cluster IN ($cluster))
)
SELECT regexp_replace(j.holder_ref, '^.*/', '') AS "Job",
       coalesce((SELECT string_agg(d.n, ', ' ORDER BY d.n) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT regexp_replace(coalesce(gm.canonical, nullif(g.raw, ''), 'Unknown model'), '^NVIDIA ', '') AS n FROM unnest(j.gpu_models) AS g (raw) LEFT JOIN gpu_model_aliases gm ON gm.raw_model = g.raw) d), 'Unknown model') AS "GPU model",
       split_part(j.holder_ref, '/', 1) AS "Namespace",
       j.cluster AS "Cluster",
       CASE WHEN j.runai THEN 'Run:ai' ELSE 'Other' END AS "Runs on",
       j.gpus AS "GPUs",
       CASE WHEN j.gpu_busy_peak IS NOT NULL
            THEN to_char(100 * j.gpu_busy_peak, 'FM990') || '%'
                 || CASE WHEN abs(j.busy_window_hours - 6) > 0.05
                         THEN ' in ' || trim_scale(round(j.busy_window_hours::numeric, 1))::text || ' h' ELSE '' END
       END AS "GPU busy (peak, 6 h)",
       CASE WHEN j.gpu_power_peak IS NOT NULL
            THEN to_char(100 * j.gpu_power_peak, 'FM990') || '%' END AS "GPU power (peak, 6 h)",
       j.status AS "Status",
       CASE WHEN j.category <> 'IDLE' THEN NULL
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM snap) THEN 'no price list'
            WHEN p.usd_h IS NULL THEN 'no AWS price'
            ELSE CASE WHEN p.any_unpriced THEN '≥ ' ELSE '' END || '$' || CASE WHEN p.usd_h * 24 >= 100 THEN to_char(p.usd_h * 24, 'FM999,999,999,990') ELSE to_char(p.usd_h * 24, 'FM990.00') END
       END AS "Waste per day at AWS prices"
FROM j
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT sum(i.gpus * r.per_gpu_hour_usd) AS usd_h, bool_or(r.per_gpu_hour_usd IS NULL) AS any_unpriced
  FROM capacity_intervals i
  LEFT JOIN gpu_model_aliases ga ON ga.raw_model = i.gpu_model
  LEFT JOIN pricing_rates r ON r.snapshot_id = (SELECT snapshot_id FROM snap) AND r.gpu_model = ga.canonical
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND i.cluster = j.cluster AND i.holder_ref = j.holder_ref
    AND i.reason_code = j.reason_code
) p ON true
ORDER BY CASE WHEN j.category = 'IDLE' THEN 1 WHEN j.category = 'UNKNOWN' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
         j.gpus DESC, "Job", "Namespace", "Cluster"
